ayahs.1: Have We not opened your chest for you, O Prophet—widened your heart to carry the weight of revelation and mission?
ayahs.3: That weighed down your back—grief, doubt, and the pressure of carrying truth to a hostile world?
ayahs.4: And raised high your mention—so your name is honoured across centuries?
ayahs.5: So indeed with hardship comes ease—
ayahs.6: Indeed with hardship comes ease—twice affirmed so no trial feels total or permanent.
ayahs.7: So when you are free from your immediate task, strive onward in devotion—
ayahs.8: And turn to your Rabb with longing.
